messages:
Ana Morales: Quick sync — marketing needs a one-page 'Enterprise Snapshot' (short preread) to support the June webinar and field outreach. Core pillars: security controls, SLA tiers, and deploy-mode guidance (hosted/dedicated/private). Can we draft a tight version by Wed? :spiral_calendar:
Liam Scott: 👍 prefer a very scannable layout — problem statement, recommended deploy mode, 3 bullets of proof (latency, cost, compliance). Hook for webinar: 'Which deploy mode wins for your SLA?'
Priya Rao: Two quick asks: 1) a single benchmark callout (headline metric), 2) an inbound routing field (so SDRs know who to loop in). Keep language plain for sales and sec reviewers.
Ben Kim: I can validate performance numbers. Tentative internally measured headlines: hosted p95 ~180ms (small models), dedicated p95 <100ms when pinned + batching. For snapshot we can say "~2x p95 improvement on Dedicated vs Hosted for latency-sensitive workloads" and caveat with model/hw.
Evan Zhou: For security section include: VPC peering, customer KMS support, audit logs retention, and on-prem/offline deployment option. Also add expected lead time for private (6–12 weeks) and compliance review note.
Liam Scott: Priya — for inbound routing, add an SFDC picklist: Deploy Interest = [Hosted | Dedicated | Private]. If Private selected, add checkbox "Needs Compliance POC". Can we script an alert to Solutions Eng on that option?
Priya Rao: Proposed copy for benchmark callout: "Bench: Dedicated reduces 95th latency by ~50% vs hosted in our in-house tests (typical gen workloads)." Keep it short and include a link to the detailed bench in the console.
Ben Kim: I'll attach the bench doc (internal) and add a short footnote with the test config: model family, sequence length, hardware type. Add a line: "Model & HW dependent — see notes."
Ana Morales: Deliverables + owners: Draft snapshot (Ana) — Wed COB; Benchmark verification + footnote (Ben) — Tue; Field-ready 1-slide summary (Priya) — Thu morning; Webinar hook + script (Liam) — Thu EOD; Inbound routing playbook (Evan) — Thu.
launch-bot: Reminder: marketing-assets-due channel set a deadline for 2024-06-05 17:00 UTC.
Evan Zhou: For routing playbook: SDR triage rules: if Deploy Interest==Dedicated and ARR>250k -> assign to AE queue A; if Private and security flagged -> assign to Enterprise AE + Solutions Eng and create a support case. I'll draft the logic in the playbook doc.
Priya Rao: Webinar format: 20 min total. 7-min framing + 7-min demo (runtime + console showing perf view & audits) + 6-min Q&A. Use the snapshot as preread and gating asset for registrants.
Liam Scott: Messaging note — do NOT promise specific latency numbers in public-facing snapshot unless we include the bench caveat. Use "typical" or "observed" qualifiers. Security copy should call out "KMS, SOC2 controls, VPC, audit logs" in checklist form.
Ben Kim: Agreed. I'll provide a short bullet list of test parameters we can append to the private variant of the snapshot for field use.
Ana Morales: Okay — I'll assemble the first draft and post in this thread when ready. @Ben Kim please DM if you need test exports. Tagging for review: @Priya Rao and @Liam Scott. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Priya Rao: Small ask — can we add a short "how to choose" decision tree (3 questions) in the snapshot? e.g., "Need compliance & isolation? -> Private; Need predictable throughput? -> Dedicated; Quick to ship? -> Hosted". Very small visual.
Liam Scott: Love that. Keep it binary and actionable. Priya, want to mock the 3-question tree? If so, I can turn it into the slide visual.
Priya Rao: I'll mock and drop PNG by Wed morning.
Evan Zhou: I'll draft the triage rules doc and include the SFDC picklist snippet and sample automation.
Ana Morales: Great. If no blockers I'll close this sync. Posting a draft Wed and requesting promo + field reviews by Thu. Thanks everyone.
